annotation.evidence_span: Clients MAY implement a fallback procedure, using a less-preferred transport if more-preferred transports fail to connect.
annotation.justification: The target clause lacks a concrete definition of preference ordering and fallback selection logic, leading to multiple reasonable implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not define how to determine which transport is "less-preferred" or "more-preferred", nor does it specify the selection logic for choosing a fallback transport when multiple transports fail to connect. This missing constraint prevents a unique operational interpretation of the fallback procedure.
